name: Charles Sanders Peirce
shortBio: American logician, scientist, and founder of Pragmatism who established modern triadic semiotics, scientific fallibilism, and the pragmatic maxim.
centralQuestion: How do the conceivable practical effects of an object constitute our entire conception of that object?

keyWorks.title: How to Make Our Ideas Clear
keyWorks.description: Seminal essay defining the pragmatic maxim and the community theory of truth.
